{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
# Flux batch script converted from PBS

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# PBS resources:
#   -l nodes=1:ppn=2:gpus=1:k80
#   -l walltime=24:00:00
#   -l mem=16GB
#   -N nott-STR-MLP
#   -M rahul@cs.nyu.edu
#   -j oe

#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 1
#flux: -c 2
#flux: --time-limit=24h
#flux: --job-name=nott-STR-MLP

# Omitted PBS option: -l gpus=1:k80
# Flux GPU requests are site/config dependent (often via custom resource types).
# Performance implication: job may be scheduled on a node without a GPU (or without the intended K80), causing failures or severe slowdown.

# Omitted PBS option: -l mem=16GB
# Flux memory requests are site/config dependent and not universally portable.
# Performance implication: job may be placed on nodes with insufficient memory, risking OOM kills or degraded performance.

# Omitted PBS option: -M rahul@cs.nyu.edu (mail recipient)
# Flux has no universal built-in batch email directive.
# Performance implication: no automatic email notifications.

# Omitted PBS option: -j oe (join stdout/stderr)
# Flux batch supports separate --output/--error; joining is not always available as a portable directive.
# Performance implication: logs may be split across stdout/stderr, complicating debugging; no runtime performance impact.

module purge
module load node
module load cmake
module load python/intel/2.7.6
module load numpy/intel/1.9.2
module load hdf5/intel/1.8.12
module load cuda/7.5.18
module load cudnn/7.0

RUNDIR=$SCRATCH/structuredinference/expt-polyphonic
cd $RUNDIR

# Run single-process training using 2 CPU cores as requested.
THEANO_FLAGS="lib.cnmem=1.,scan.allow_gc=False,compiledir_format=gpu0" \
  python2.7 train_dkf.py -vm R -infm structured -ttype mlp -dset nottingham-sorted
"
}

PBS requested 16GB of memory (`-l mem=16GB`) but the Flux resource section has no memory request; the allocation may be under-provisioned on memory-constrained systems.
issues: The workload sets `THEANO_FLAGS` with `compiledir_format=gpu0`, implying it expects a GPU to be available; without a GPU resource request, runtime failure is likely.
